task: Shared dispatch and private driver conversations

behavior.dispatch: One deterministic company+canonical-driver conversation, shared by current trusted viewDispatch+viewChat staff; sendChat additionally required to write. Read-only dispatch staff can read. Independent of shifts and staff roster. Other drivers excluded.
behavior.private: Separate deterministic company+canonical-driver+authenticated-staff pair. Only that pair admitted through governed APIs; no role fan-in or shared-monitor storage.
behavior.storage: New dispatch_conversations collection; direct client reads/writes denied by deployed catch-all. Existing legacy chat_threads history retained in place, not relabeled private and not migrated. Existing driver monitor falls back to history until its team conversation exists.
behavior.levels: Processed calibrated level report is sent once only to dispatch_team; never private or legacy direct. Company sendLevelToDispatch remains authoritative. Existing stable logical-pull dedup, managed retries, computed bottom, real names and timestamps retained.
behavior.identity: Real profile names; no new account/role changes.
